messages:
frank: kicking off staggered rollout for v2.8.0 at 18:20 UTC. embed-eu will flip to modelx:quant-lite in eu-west1 then eu-central after 5m.
deploy-bot: Canary started: staged regions eu-west1 -> eu-central. details: https://deploys.redwood.internal/6834129000 :robot_face:
lena: quick FYI, synth prefill p95 on eu-west1 jumped from ~85ms -> 320ms ~90s after first stage. small user impact but synth shows clear tail.
sre-oncall: runbook check: if synth p95 > 300ms for >2m OR kv-miss delta >10% during staged rollout, pause and triage.
frank: checking kv metrics now — kv-miss delta is +9% but trending. not over 10% yet.
smoke-bot: triggered immediate rerun of embed-kv-prefill in eu-west1. ETA ~30s.
smoke-bot: rerun results: pre-pin p95 318ms, kv-miss +10% (borderline), prefill retries x2 :warning:
lena: hmm borderline. eu-central not yet staged. I suggest pausing before staging next region and applying a short regional pinback if we see sustained tail.
frank: pausing staged rollout for 15m window. will not stage to eu-central until we clear.
release-coordinator: good call. add hold to release notes and mark rollout paused. also toggle alert for kv-prefill heatmap >8% during staged rollouts.
sre-oncall: while pausing, we should try a config pin to the fp16 variant in eu-west1 to see if tail disappears with minimal blast radius. runbook allows regional pin for borderline cases.
frank: running pin: `rdctl routes pin --route embed-eu --region eu-west1 --variant modelx:fp16 --reason "staged canary: prefill tail observed; pausing staging"`
deploy-bot: Route config patched; rollout id r-2026-07-19-6834.
smoke-bot: rerun after pin... results: p95 108ms, kv-miss +1%, retries baseline. :white_check_mark:
lena: nice. I'll keep sampling for 10m to ensure no tail re-emerges.
sre-oncall: filing tracker PERF-5022: "staggered staged rollout reveals prefills oscillation with quant-lite; investigate prefetch ordering and warmup jitter" and attaching traces + smoke runs.
release-coordinator: adding release note: "v2.8.0: staged rollout paused; eu-west1 temporarily pinned to fp16 after synthetic prefill tail observed. investigation open (PERF-5022)."
frank: will resume staging to eu-central only after 20m observation and a clean heatmap. leaving thread open for 25m. thanks folks. :thumbsup:
